name: web/CRLF response-header injection
description: [high] Proves CRLF response-header injection: %0d%0a inside the path splits a new X-Crlproof header into the response (leads to cache/queue poisoning and XSS via injected headers). Keywords: crlf injection response splitting header injection http. ctrl: benign path adds no header -> not falsified. base_url = site root.
